verdict.rationale: Figma provides webhooks, REST API, plugins, and an MCP server for design/code workflows, but there is no evidence of a scheduling/automation-runner mechanism that lets users configure something to run autonomously in the background on a recurring or triggered basis without manual invocation. Webhooks only notify external systems of events; they are not user-configurable autonomous automations within Figma itself. missing for 10: any documented scheduler, cron-like trigger, or 'run in background unattended' automation builder within Figma or Figma Make.
